question: What offering formula is prescribed by assigning the bīja krīṃ to the kīlaka across all limbs?
premises: The formula places krīṃ in relation to all limbs.
The bīja krīṃ is assigned to the kīlaka by dative offering.
The clause closes with the obeisance formula namaḥ.
inference: Verse 1301 prescribes the mantra offering: in all limbs, krīṃ to the kīlaka, obeisance.
uncertainties: Exact ritual function of kīlaka here is not specified in this verse alone.
plain_english: In all limbs, (offer) krīṃ to the kīlaka: obeisance.
